title: Cozy Craft (client)
description: Official client modpack for Cozy Craft
body:
This mod pack includes our recommended/needed list of mods to enjoy the full Cozy Craft Experience, tho still feel free to add mods to your liking. For our Server Mod Pack go here: [Inlcude sever link here]

This mod pack includes the following mods:
- AppleSkin
- CC:Tweaked
- Chat Heads
- Cobblemon
- Cobblemon Secret Base Trainer
- Cobblemon Mega Showdown
- Continuity
- Create
- Create Deco
- Create Liquid Fuel
- Create Slice & Dice
- Create Cobblemon Manufactory
- Create Copycats+
- Create Dragons Plus
- Create Enchantment Industry
- Create New Age
- Dynamic FPS
- EntityCulling
- Fast IP Ping
- Ferrite Core
- Freecam
- ImediatlyFast
- Immersive Aircraft
- Iris
- Jade
- Just Enough Items
- Krypton Foxified
- LambDynamicLights
- Model Gap Fix
- Open Parties and Claims
- ShulkerBoxTooltip
- Sodium
- Sophisticated Backpacks
- Xaero's Minimap
- Xaero's World Map

It also contains the following necessary dependencies:
- .connector
- Accesssories
- Architectury
- Cobblemore Lib
- Entity Model Features
- Entity Texture Features
- Forgified Fabric API
- Kotlin For Forge
- owo
- Sinytra Connector
- Sophisticated Core
